custom.placeholder: E.g.: open a ticket with the receipt and share your server ID.

discord_role.label: Discord role

actions.addAnother: Deliver one more thing in the same purchase

invoice.apiKeySaved: Saved. Paste another to replace it.
invoice.codesHint: The codes come from your accountant. The key never comes back to the screen after it is saved.

fivemStore.announceOn: Purchases will be announced on the server.

directory.listed: The store shows in the store list.

directory.hint: Shows the store on the public page with every MRI BOT store, with search and categories. Nobody sees how much you sell: the order follows recent activity.
